cards.name: Birthing Ritual
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, if you control a creature, look at the top seven cards of your library. Then you may sacrifice a creature. If you do, you may put a creature card with mana value X or less from among those cards onto the battlefield, where X is 1 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

III — Draw two cards for each opponent who controls fewer creatures than you.
